Scaffold.title: Send a feeling, not just a gift.
Scaffold.subtitle: Scaffold is live. Phase 2 wires the full landing page; Phase 3 ships the recipient envelope; Phases 4–8 add the five gift builders.
Scaffold.footer: Made with care in Hong Kong · 為香港而設

hero.tag: Made in Hong Kong · 為香港而設
hero.lede: LoveByte turns your photos, voice notes, and words into a one-of-a-kind digital gift — a memory card game, a love letter, a quiz only they'd know how to pass.

cards.title: Memory card game
cards.body: Pick photos. We turn them into a matching game. Every match unlocks a memory.

puzzle.title: Photo puzzle
puzzle.body: Drag tiles back into place. The picture they were missing is the point.

quiz.title: "How well do you know me?" quiz
quiz.body: Multiple-choice questions only they'd get right. Wrong answers are funny. Right answers are sweet.

collage.title: Multimedia collage
collage.body: Photos, short video, a song, your captions. Browsable, not just scrolled past.

letter.title: Animated letter
letter.body: A scroll-reveal letter that opens like a real envelope. Photos and voice notes drop in as you read.

1.title: Pick a format
1.body: Five gift types to choose from. Each one designed for a different kind of "I love you".

2.title: Add the personal bits
2.body: Photos, a voice note, your words. We help you arrange them so the moment hits right.

3.title: Send the link
3.body: One link, one QR code. Open it on their phone, they get the whole experience.
